clock.confirmed_latency_distribution: Not established. One summary is not a LONG/SHORT delivery-latency estimate
clock.delivery: Direct controller relay after calculation and ledger checkpoints; not held until the ChatGPT hourly report
clock.h1_label: BEGIN of H1, not its end

historical_example.message_type: NO_SIGNAL summary, not a trading signal

clock.schedule: Controller cron19,39,55; early starts wait until :18:02. H1 cron25, Telegram cron50 are additional triggers/fallbacks

costs.exchange: Observed BUYSELLFEE; historical value must not be replaced silently by current metadata
costs.margin: Observed exchange INITIALMARGIN; broker-specific uplift unknown
costs.tariff_scope: User tariff as a fixed current-cost scenario; not a reconstruction of past broker debits
costs.valuation: Minute price increments at last available indicative USD/RUB, BR multiplier10 / GOLD multiplier1; exact clearing not reconstructed

data_source: apim.moex.com only; no public ISS live fallback

LONG: close > max(high of previous 20 H1), current H1 excluded
EMA20 > EMA50 on both H1 and completed H4
H1 volume >= 0.6 * median(volume of previous 20 H1)
entry.SHORT: All directional inequalities reversed; same ADX and volume gates
entry.decision: Only the latest required closed H1; no intrabar confirmed signal
entry.drift: Entry including 2 adverse ticks must be within 0.5 ATR14 of signal H1 close
entry.identity: Real contract/asset/expiry must match the source report
entry.quote: Positive BID/OFFER, spread <=5 ticks, independent entry quote no older than 90 seconds
entry.uid: contract:BUY_or_SELL:H1_begin_msk; one processing attempt per portfolio, no hindsight re-entry

exit.gaps: Stop may fill beyond stop at adverse opening price
exit.notification: Exit report can arrive later than the modeled minute touch; not an observed broker fill
exit.partial_entry_minute_touch: Unresolved ordering -> REVIEW_REQUIRED and halt; no invented exit
exit.protection: On eligible complete M1, adverse 2 ticks and commissions
exit.publication: M1 end +18 min must precede the controller observation
exit.roll: Exit beginning at expires minus 8 calendar days
exit.same_full_minute_stop_and_target: Stop first, explicitly a conservative model

known_gaps: Historical executable BID/OFFER and quote availability
Historical exchange economics and complete contract-selection universe
Broker uplift, actual fills and exact clearing

levels.actual_virtual_entry: Fresh OFFER for LONG / BID for SHORT plus 2 adverse ticks
levels.realized_reward_risk: May differ from reference 2R because the delayed entry price changes
levels.reference: Signal H1 close, not a guaranteed fill
levels.stop: Reference - direction * 1.5 ATR14, rounded to the actual tick

live_week.deadline_exit: New entries stop at deadline; closing waits for required M1 coverage and fresh quote. No fictitious deadline fill

name: Donchian H1 with H1/H4 EMA alignment

position_size.risk_includes: Stop distance, modeled adverse exit ticks, entry/exit commissions
position_size.volume_cap: 1% of median volume of previous 20 H1

trading_hours: No fixed assumed market-open schedule. Require current valid candles/quotes. A missing H1 is a data error, not proof of a closed market.

universe.contract: Maximum current VOLTODAY among eligible real contracts
universe.historical_selection_requires: Point-in-time eligible universe and VOLTODAY; nearest expiry is only a labelled approximation

warmup.h4: Four consecutive H1 in Moscow 00/04/08/12/16/20 hour blocks; incomplete blocks omitted
